karate.licence: free for scientific use, to the best of the compiler's knowledge (Newman's netdata)
karate.why: the smallest classic social graph: every check is cheap and hand-checkable

lesmis.why: the one reachable keepset graph whose recipe keeps real edge weights (co-appearance counts): dijkstra, weighted pagerank and weighted modularity

celegans.why: a small directed graph with nodes that only send or only receive: bfs out-edges, in- and out-degree

polblogs.licence: free for scientific use, to the best of the compiler's knowledge (Newman's netdata)
polblogs.why: directed hyperlinks with parallel edges and self-loops, so the build's deduplication and the self-loop rules are exercised on real data

london_transport.why: a sparse, near-planar transport network: long shortest paths, few triangles, a low degeneracy (keepset's topology recipe drops its layer weights)

transport-airline.why: airline routes keyed by IATA codes: text ids of three bytes, the short end of the id-length distribution

facebook.why: a dense, clustered social graph: many triangles, high core numbers and strong communities

kg-codex-s.why: a small Wikidata knowledge graph with 42 relations and Wikidata Q-ids as text ids

wn18rr.why: WordNet offsets as ids: digit strings with leading zeros, which are text and must not be read as integers; 11 relations and self-loops

cit-hepth.why: a citation graph, nearly acyclic and directed (cora and citeseer were unreachable from this machine)

email-enron.why: a communication graph listed in both directions: half its edges are deduplicated as undirected

fb15k-237.why: Freebase machine ids (/m/...) as text ids, 237 relations: the multi-relation build at scale

ss-gleich-usroads-48.why: the road network of the 48 contiguous US states: a large diameter and degree at most 7

dblp.why: the co-authorship graph of computer science bibliography, about a million edges with strong communities

yago3-10.why: entity names as text ids (Wikipedia titles), 37 relations: the long, varied end of the id-length distribution

hetionet.licence: CC0 1.0 for original content, each integrated source under its own licence (Hetionet v1.0)
hetionet.why: a biomedical knowledge graph of 24 relations whose ids are typed CURIE-like strings (Gene::9021, Biological Process::GO:0071357) with long shared prefixes

roadnet-tx.why: the Texas road network, 1.4M nodes listed in both directions: the largest medium graph and a high diameter

livejournal.why: a 35M-edge social graph, the §13 large tier

ogbn-mag.licence: ODC-By-1.0 (OGB ogbn-mag, from Microsoft Academic Graph)
ogbn-mag.why: a heterogeneous academic graph of four relations with typed text ids (paper:123), 21M edges, the §13 large tier
